period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, Jan-Mar 2024 (Q1). Sourced from a DSE (dsebd.org) company-page table titled 'Interim Financial Performance: 2024', recovered via a Wayback Machine capture from 2025-01-08. FY2024's own annual report/audited financial statements are confirmed unavailable elsewhere in this dataset (no Wayback capture, live site Cloudflare-blocked) - this quarter, together with 2024_Q2.json and 2024_Q3.json, is therefore this dataset's ONLY FY2024 coverage of any kind from interim sources; note that a separate DSE 'Auditors_opinion' PDF (see annual_reports/RUPALIBANK/rupalibank-dse-auditors-opinion-2024.txt) independently recovered some FY2024 ANNUAL/year-end figures this same session (a qualified audit opinion, a BDT 15,375.30 crore provision shortfall, CRAR 2.95%/3.03% Solo/Consolidated, paid-up capital BDT 487.93 crore) - that is FY2024 Q4/annual-position data, out of scope for this Q1-Q3 task, and is documented in sources.json/insights.json instead rather than as a quarterly JSON file here. Same DSE-table caveats as 2023_Q1.json (EPS/price only, no profit-in-BDT figures shown by DSE from this vintage onward; Solo basis presumed, not explicitly labeled).
